Chasing costs 14.1 runs in the CPL — but that hides a wide spread

Across 286 matches at these grounds a first innings averages 149.3 and a chase 135.2, at 7.12 runs an over. On first-innings scoring that places the CPL 7th among the 10 T20 leagues we hold ground data for, against PSL at 172.4 and BPL at 139.2.

The league average is the least interesting number on this page. Chasing costs 24.1 runs at Providence Stadium, Guyana and only 4.4 at Brian Lara Stadium, Tarouba. The highest-scoring ground on the list is Warner Park, St Kitts at 7.53 an over. A total that wins comfortably at one of these grounds loses at another.

Sample sizes vary a lot — a ground with five matches behind it deserves far less weight than one with a hundred, and both are in the table rather than hidden behind an average. The live model does not use these figures: once a ball is bowled it reads the actual over-by-over run and wicket pattern instead.

How the live prediction works

It starts when the match does. There is no pre-match tip here. Win probability is recalculated after every ball from the score, wickets in hand, balls and runs remaining, and how the pitch is behaving in this innings rather than on average.

Measured, not claimed. 81.5% win-probability accuracy on a true holdout: trained on 2017-2024 matches only, then scored on 2,546 matches from 2025-26 the model had never seen. Accuracy rises through an innings, from 79.2% at over 6 to 82.2% by over 15.

Next-over forecasts too. Expected runs for the coming over land inside the published range 72.3% of the time, measured across 46,718 over-boundary snapshots.

CPL predictions — FAQs

Which CPL ground is hardest to chase at?
Providence Stadium, Guyana. Across 45 matches there, sides batting first average 142.3 and sides chasing 118.2 — a 24.1-run gap. The most forgiving is Brian Lara Stadium, Tarouba, where the same gap is 4.4.
What is a good score in the Caribbean Premier League?
Across 286 matches at the grounds listed, a first innings averages 149.3 and a chase 135.2, at 7.12 runs an over. That puts the CPL 7th of the 10 T20 leagues we track for first-innings scoring, against PSL at 172.4 and BPL at 139.2.
Who will win tonight's CPL match?
We do not publish pre-match tips. The model is a live model: it has nothing useful to say until a ball is bowled, and then recalculates win probability after every one from the score, wickets in hand, required rate and how the pitch is actually playing. It measures 81.5% accuracy on a true holdout — trained on 2017-2024 matches only, then scored on 2,546 matches from 2025-26 it had never seen.
Where do these numbers come from?
Ball-by-ball records for the grounds this competition uses, 286 matches in total. They are T20 records for each ground rather than records for this competition alone, so read them as ground character. Sample sizes are shown per ground in the table — some are small, and a ground with 5 matches behind it deserves less weight than one with 100.
